{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Drop the 6 QA rows with revenue = '999,999.99'
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != '999,999.99']

# Verify the drop
print(f'Number of rows after dropping QA rows: {len(df_clean)}')
print(f'Number of QA rows in cleaned data: {len(df_clean[df_clean["revenue"] == "999,999.99"])}')

# Confirm the original data had 900 rows
print(f'Original data shape: {df.shape}')"}
